notes.title: Update - Casino Simulator 2024
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011550/1f26d8a861cd72b98f6f28aef5465ffa858467cf.jpg[/img][b]

[h1]Hello Gamblers!![/h1][/b]
[i][b][h3]Thank you for supporting us in the development process of our game. We are sharing the first update to be made this month.[/h3][/b][/i]

[b]- You will be able to distribute brochures in the game and advertise your casino. You will gain more customers from these advertisements.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011550/22d3e6251a0cf36e3c27b3c400e1babe949755a5.png[/img]

[b]- Your customers in the casino may cheat. You will need to expel them from your casino.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011550/a055d1fb5d0e79d137fbd46532174fc9895d9eb0.png[/img]
[b]- Camera and alarm systems have been added to detect cheaters in your casino. You can buy these systems from the store.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011550/8afe5fa9ae4048aa2ba68758eb76c9281a4692fb.png[/img]
[b]- There is now a mafia in the game. This mafia will ask for tribute from you on some days. If you do not pay the tribute, it will damage your casino.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011550/44591875657a9343bb3632f790cc515b39fc9e16.png[/img]

[b]- Sign advertising systems have been added to the game.
- Online Casino earnings have been increased.
- Toilets can now be opened at level 1.
- Slot and table sound adjustment features have been added to the settings
- Some areas in the game have been made more descriptive.
- You will now be able to sleep in your new home.[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2836450/Casino_Simulator_2024/

[h1][b]What we plan to do in the next update.[/b][/h1]

[b]- New levels.
- New areas.
- New tables.
- New decorations.
- New games.
- New casino improvements.[/b]

[b]We take into account the requests of our community and welcome your comments during the development phase.[/b]

[url=https://discord.gg/6v9NZXVUrf][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011550/eded40b341881d2865ed86d8f697f38f092a94b5.png[/img][/url]

notes.notes:

[i][b][h1] Hello, Gamblers !![/h1][/b][/i]

- Fixed typos.
- New lamps added.
- Added a close button to the Paint menu.
- Updated music on the laptop.[/b]
[b]- Increased decoration limits.
- Added a warning for purchase restrictions.
- Fixed some bugs in the building system.
- Blackjack and roulette game names have been added[/b]
